projects.title: Is the Weighted Sum a Meritocratic Method?
projects.subtitle: A Mechanism Design Approach to Research Assistant Recruitment in Turkey
projects.question: How do weighted scores and GPA normalization shape fairness and incentives in research-assistant recruitment?
projects.approach: A mechanism-design framework for comparing score aggregation and GPA normalization rules in terms of fairness, robustness, and manipulability.
projects.contribution: Developing the framework and evaluating alternative recruitment mechanisms against normative criteria for fair and manipulation-resistant selection.

projects.title: An Allocation of Pharmacy Shifts
projects.subtitle: A Mechanism Design Approach
projects.question: How can pharmacy duty schedules satisfy hard feasibility requirements while accounting for fairness and spatial distribution?
projects.approach: Matching theory and mechanism design, combining theoretical analysis of feasible assignments with simulations using real-world scheduling data.
projects.contribution: Contributing to the characterization of feasible assignments, the design of implementable mechanisms, and simulation analysis.
